project_goal: Monitor submitted alpha E5repQ81 and open the next lower-correlation follow-up branch around analyst disagreement, with a non-analyst fallback kept ready.

features.title: Record the fresh official OS status for E5repQ81
features.description: Capture the current official OS Testing Status for the submitted alpha E5repQ81 without reopening submission review.
acceptance_criteria: A markdown status memo exists under runs/submission-memos.
The memo records a fresh official-page status check timestamp.
The memo does not claim a final OS outcome unless the official page shows one.

features.title: Create the third-cycle follow-up research queue
features.description: Build the next queue around the analyst disagreement branch and one non-analyst fallback lane.
acceptance_criteria: A real queue JSON exists under runs/research-queues.
The queue is compatible with the local research_queue_builder script.
The queue contains the analyst disagreement branch and at least one non-analyst fallback.

features.title: Create the analyst disagreement field-search pack
features.description: Create a field-search pack for the fresh post-submit follow-up branch around anl4_afv4_dts_spe.
acceptance_criteria: A markdown field-search pack exists under runs/field-search-packs.
The pack records fresh official field verification for the chosen disagreement field.
The pack clearly separates confirmed facts from planning assumptions.

features.title: Draft the analyst disagreement expression family
features.description: Create a simple inverse-disagreement baseline plus small, justified variants for the new follow-up branch.
acceptance_criteria: A markdown expression family file exists under runs/expression-families.
The file includes one baseline and at least three variants.
The variants change one major lever at a time.

features.title: Capture the analyst disagreement simulation results
features.description: Record real platform metrics and evidence for the analyst disagreement branch once the new expressions are simulated.
acceptance_criteria: A simulation capture JSON exists under runs/simulation-captures.
The capture includes real platform metrics only.
Evidence artifacts exist for the capture.

features.title: Build the analyst disagreement candidate batch
features.description: Convert the real disagreement-branch simulation outputs into a submit / polish / branch / kill candidate batch.
acceptance_criteria: A candidate batch JSON exists under runs/candidate-batches.
The candidate batch is compatible with the local candidate_scorecard script.
The batch contains real metrics only.

features.title: Write the third-cycle daily note
features.description: Record the post-submit continuation session in the daily note format after the planning artifacts and first disagreement tests exist.
acceptance_criteria: A daily note JSON exists under runs/notes/daily.
The JSON is compatible with the local session_note_scaffold daily mode.
The note references real work from the current cycle.
